the pyrolysis of PCB can be used to produce a high-quality pyrolytic oils with high purity, and this oil can be used for the synthesis of biofuel.

the alkali treatment method can improve the extraction rate of oil from the pyrolysis residue of scrap PCBs and the purity of the extracted oil is improved through the acidification-extraction-vaccum distillation process.
